import hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path("evidence/workflow-005-session")
for name in ("local_model.py","orchestrate.py","tests/test_local_model.py","tests/test_orchestrate.py"):
    source=pathlib.Path(name)
    backup=root/"before"/name
    restored=root/"restore-proof"/name
    backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    restored.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with backup.open("xb") as stream: stream.write(source.read_bytes())
    with restored.open("xb") as stream: stream.write(backup.read_bytes())
    assert source.read_bytes()==restored.read_bytes()
    print(json.dumps({"file":name,"restore_proven":True,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))

import hashlib,json,pathlib
import orchestrate as orch,local_model
session=pathlib.Path("evidence/workflow-005-session")
parents={"fast":"evidence/workflow-004-fast/runs/8d2a7578-1f53-4026-821d-96edfa13c425","strong":"evidence/workflow-004-strong/runs/fb2decad-ce1d-4a15-8d5f-ce1d6c2c91eb"}
for route,parent in parents.items():
    base,config,task,profile,repo,evaluator=orch.load_state(pathlib.Path("evidence/workflow-004-"+route))
    run=pathlib.Path(parent)
    assert config==orch.load_json(run/"config.snapshot.json")
    assert task==orch.load_json(run/"task.snapshot.json")
    assert task["evaluator_sha256"]=="e407fb60107cf97153713039a6a7ed8cd4ca2729f15b0024d91c3847771df601"
    orch._verify_base(repo,task["base_commit"])
    files,source=orch._candidate_input(run,config,task)
    messages=orch._prompt(task,repo,config["limits"]["max_patch_bytes"],files)
    spec=config["models"][route]
    body=local_model._validate_request(spec["provider_model"],messages,spec["max_output_tokens"],spec["timeout_seconds"],orch._patch_response_format(task))
    old=json.loads((pathlib.Path("evidence/repair-feedback-audit-session/export-02")/(route+"-request.reconstructed.json")).read_bytes())
    new=json.loads(body)
    old_user=json.loads(old["messages"][1]["content"])
    new_user=json.loads(new["messages"][1]["content"])
    assert new_user["files"]==files
    assert all("raise NotImplementedError" not in row["content"] for row in files)
    replaced=dict(new_user)
    replaced["files"]=old_user["files"]
    assert replaced==old_user
    unchanged=json.loads(body)
    unchanged["messages"]=old["messages"]
    assert unchanged==old
    assert messages[0]==old["messages"][0]
    assert new_user["objective"]==old_user["objective"]
    with (session/(route+"-request.expected.json")).open("xb") as f:f.write(body)

    orch.write_new(session/(route+"-prepared.json"),record)
    print(json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True))

import ast,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess
import orchestrate as orch
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();session=root/"evidence/workflow-005-session"

assert subprocess.check_output(["pwsh","-NoProfile","-Command","@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name = 'ovms.exe'\").Count"],text=True).strip()=="0"
transcript=[json.loads(line) for line in (session/"transcript.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
test=next(row for row in transcript if row["stdout_file"]=="06-full-tests.stdout")
assert test["exit_code"]==0
tests_stderr=(session/test["stderr_file"]).read_text()
assert "Ran 145 tests" in tests_stderr and tests_stderr.rstrip().endswith("OK")
rows=[]
for route,path in runs.items():
    run=root/path; prepared=orch.load_json(session/(route+"-prepared.json"))
    parent=root/prepared["parent_run"]
    events=orch._events(run)
    assert events[-1]["event"]=="failed"
    completed=[event for event in events if event["event"]=="model_completed"]
    verified=[event for event in events if event["event"]=="verified"]
    assert len(completed)==len(verified)==1
    assert events[0]["candidate_input"]==prepared["input_source"]
    assert events[0]["config_hash"]==prepared["config_digest"]
    assert events[0]["task_hash"]==prepared["task_digest"]
    actual=(run/"model-io/request.json").read_bytes()

    assert actual==expected
    request=json.loads(actual)
    response=orch.load_json(run/"model-io/response.body")
    model=orch.load_json(run/"model-output.json")
    assert response["choices"][0]["finish_reason"]=="stop"
    assert response["usage"]==model["usage"]
    assert request["max_tokens"]==1024 and request["stream"] is False
    assert orch.load_json(run/"model-io/request.metadata.json")["timeout_seconds"]==120
    assert len(request["messages"])==2
    user=json.loads(request["messages"][1]["content"])
    task=orch.load_json(run/"task.snapshot.json"); config=orch.load_json(run/"config.snapshot.json")
    assert task==orch.load_json(parent/"task.snapshot.json")
    assert config==orch.load_json(parent/"config.snapshot.json")
    previous=orch.load_json(parent/"model-output.json")
    before=json.loads(previous["content"])["files"][0]["content"]
    after=json.loads(model["content"])["files"][0]["content"]
    assert user["files"]==json.loads(previous["content"])["files"]
    assert user["objective"]==task["objective"]
    assert orch.file_hash(run/"trusted-evaluator/test_solution.py")==task["evaluator_sha256"]
    base,_,_,_,repo,_=orch.load_state(root/("evidence/workflow-004-"+route))
    orch._verify_base(repo,task["base_commit"])
    verdict=orch.load_json(run/"verifier.stdout")
    stderr=(run/"verifier.stderr").read_text()
    outcomes={m.group(1):m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^(test_\w+) \(.*\) \.\.\. (ok|FAIL)$",stderr)}
    diff="".join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True),after.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile="previous/solution.py",tofile="repair/solution.py"))
    with (session/(route+"-repair.diff")).open("x",encoding="utf-8",newline="") as f:f.write(diff)
